one_liner: Cheerful, clumsy 'totally ordinary' girl who shouts 'ei, ei, mun!' and refuses to stay ordinary.
personality: Bubbly, upbeat and a bit scatterbrained: she talks in sound effects ('baban!', 'herororo~'), forgets to buy the chocolate she went to look at, and slips and gets nosebleeds. She calls herself completely ordinary but has a gutsy, tough streak and badly wants fans to remember her and to answer their cheers. She is warm and grateful toward her trainer, offering to 'split in half' joys and memories.

story_arc.summary: A self-described 'ordinary' girl from a family-run diner, Tannhauser wants to break past being ordinary and win something everyone will remember (events '『普通』の先へ', 'それでも、夢見て、1等賞！'). Her career runs through the Classics and long races like the Diamond Stakes and Tenno Sho (Spring), with friends cheering from the stands; per the wiki a nosebleed always cancels her senior-year Japan Cup objective, mirroring the real horse's 1994 withdrawal. It peaks with a long-awaited win at the Arima Kinen ('有馬記念の後に・待ちかねた勝利').
story_arc.source: event titles + web: https://umamusu.wiki/Matikanetannhauser; model knowledge (unverified) for framing
